name: Grid
description: Arranges items into responsive columns with one shared gap.

columns.description: Number of columns: a number (1-12), a responsive object { base, sm, md, lg, xl }, or "auto" for auto-fill
constraints: Use "auto" with minChildWidth for fully fluid layouts
Use responsive object for explicit breakpoint control: { base: 1, md: 2, lg: 3 }

gap.description: Gap between grid items. Accepts string tokens or numbers (1-8) mapped to the spacing scale

alignItems.description: Vertical alignment of items within their cells

justifyItems.description: Horizontal alignment of items within their cells

padding.description: Internal padding of the grid container

when: Cards, tiles, or media that reflow across breakpoints
whenNot: Editorial mosaics with feature tiles (use BentoGrid)
guidelines: columns="auto" with minChildWidth adapts without breakpoints
Pass { base, md, lg } to columns for explicit per-breakpoint control
Numeric gaps (1-8) map to the same spacing scale as the tokens
Wrap a child in Grid.Item to span columns; colSpan="full" spans the row
Keep source order equal to visual order — Grid does not reorder for screen readers
accessibility: Grid is purely visual — it does not affect reading order or semantics
Ensure logical source order matches visual order for screen readers

examples.name: Default
examples.description: A fixed count of equal columns.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Grid } from '@/components/Grid';

<Box width="100%">
  <Grid columns={3} gap="md">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">One</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Two</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Three</Box>
  </Grid>
</Box>

examples.name: Responsive
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Grid } from '@/components/Grid';

<Box width="100%">
  <Grid columns={{ base: 1, md: 2, lg: 3 }} gap="md">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 1</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 2</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 3</Box>
  </Grid>
</Box>

examples.name: Auto-fill
examples.description: Columns fit themselves to a minimum child width — no breakpoints needed.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Grid } from '@/components/Grid';

<Box width="100%">
  <Grid columns="auto" minChildWidth="10rem" gap="md">
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 1</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 2</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 3</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Card 4</Box>
  </Grid>
</Box>

examples.name: With Spanning
examples.description: Grid.Item stretches a child across columns.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Grid } from '@/components/Grid';

<Box width="100%">
  <Grid columns={4} gap="md">
    <Grid.Item colSpan={2}>
      <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Spans 2 columns</Box>
    </Grid.Item>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">1 col</Box>
    <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">1 col</Box>
    <Grid.Item colSpan="full">
      <Box background="secondary" rounded="sm" padding="sm">Full width</Box>
    </Grid.Item>
  </Grid>
</Box>

examples.name: Form Layout
examples.description: Paired fields with one full-width row.
examples.code:
import { Box } from '@/components/Box';
import { Field } from '@/components/Field';
import { Grid } from '@/components/Grid';
import { Input } from '@/components/Input';

<Box width="100%">
  <Grid columns={{ base: 1, md: 2 }} gap="md">
    <Field>
      <Field.Label>First name</Field.Label>
      <Input placeholder="Ada" />
    </Field>
    <Field>
      <Field.Label>Last name</Field.Label>
      <Input placeholder="Lovelace" />
    </Field>
    <Grid.Item colSpan="full">
      <Field>
        <Field.Label>Email address</Field.Label>
        <Input type="email" placeholder="ada@example.com" />
      </Field>
    </Grid.Item>
  </Grid>
</Box>

relations.note: Grid commonly contains Card components for dashboard and tile layouts

propsSummary: columns: 1-12 | { base, sm, md, lg, xl } | "auto" (default: 1)
minChildWidth: string — min width for auto-fill (only with columns="auto")
gap: none|xs|sm|md|lg|xl|number (default: md, number maps to space scale)
Pass-through DOM props supported on Grid and Grid.Item roots (id, role, aria-*, data-*, handlers)
